scope: Week 2 draft: every footprint with a specific use label (not bare D/S/F), plus fuel, oil and boiler/engine rooms. Plain dwellings, stores and unlabeled sheds are not listed. Groups of identical footprints (e.g. a row of KILNs) are one entry with the count in notes.

buildings.label: DAIRY
buildings.notes: Crossed box = stable; '5423' printed on Bischoff margin

notes: Mostly vacant in 1903: blocks 4042, 4043 empty, scattered frame dwellings along Daggett/Edwards and Macklind. Other feature: a POND in block 4041 near Wilson & Bischoff, possibly a flooded clay pit next to the Sanders brickworks (sheet 15). Good test of 'no false positives' on a sparse sheet.
